app.name: Frontend Reliability Lab
app.tagline: Observe how a React frontend behaves under real API and network failures.

pokedex.title: Pokédex
pokedex.description: Browse Pokémon served by the PokéAPI.

lab.title: Reliability Lab
lab.description: Pick a failure scenario and watch how the app reacts.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.description: Check your internet connection. Loading resumes automatically when it comes back.

network.title: Connection problem
network.description: The request could not be completed. Check your connection and try again.

timeout.title: The server took too long
timeout.description: The server did not answer in time. Trying again usually works.

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.description: The server has no record of what was requested.

server.title: The server had a problem
server.description: The service is failing or unavailable right now. Trying again in a moment may work.

rateLimited.title: Too many requests
rateLimited.description: The service asked us to slow down. Wait a moment and try again.

client.title: Request rejected
client.description: The server refused this request. Trying again will not change the result.

malformed.title: Unexpected response
malformed.description: The server replied, but the data was not in the expected format, so it was not used.

unexpected.title: Something went wrong
unexpected.description: An unexpected error occurred while displaying this page.

offline.banner: You are offline. Saved data stays available and loading resumes automatically when the connection returns.

waiting.title: Waiting for a connection
waiting.description: This will load automatically as soon as you are back online.

stale.title: Could not refresh
stale.description: Showing the last data we have. It may be out of date.

noMatches.title: No Pokémon found
noMatches.description: Nothing matches “{query}”. Check the spelling or try a shorter name.

outOfRange.title: That page does not exist
outOfRange.description: There are no Pokémon on page {page}.

scenario.hint: Pick a failure to simulate. It applies to every request the app makes, on every page.
scenario.error: The simulation could not start. Service workers may be unavailable in this browser.

normal.name: Normal
normal.description: Requests go to the real PokéAPI, untouched.
normal.expected: Data loads quickly and the app behaves as in production. Nothing is intercepted.

slow.name: Slow response
slow.description: Every request takes a few seconds.
slow.expected: A loading state stays visible for about 3 seconds, then the data appears. Nothing is retried: the request succeeds, it is only slow.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.expected: Each attempt gives up after 6 seconds. The app retries twice with backoff (about 20 seconds in total), then shows a timeout error with a manual retry.

http404.name: HTTP 404
http404.expected: The app shows a “not found” error at once. It does not retry, because retrying a 404 cannot help, and it offers no retry button.

http500.name: HTTP 500
http500.description: Every request fails with a server error.
http500.expected: The app retries twice (3 attempts in total), then shows a server error with a “Try again” button. Switching to Normal and retrying recovers without reloading the page.

network.name: Network error
network.description: The connection drops before any answer.
network.expected: Retried twice like a 500, but the message says the connection failed, not that the server did.

malformed.name: Malformed response
malformed.description: The server answers 200 with data in the wrong shape.
malformed.expected: Validation rejects the data: an “unexpected response” error and no retry, because the same body would fail again. The log shows “Malformed” even though the status was 200.

random.name: Random failure
random.description: About half of the requests fail in different ways.
random.expected: Most failures are absorbed by retries and never reach the screen; now and then three attempts fail in a row and an error appears. The same seed replays the same sequence.

flaky.name: Flaky, then recovers
flaky.description: Each URL fails twice, then works.
flaky.expected: The first two attempts of every URL fail with a 503 and the third succeeds: the retry policy hides the problem. Only the log and the retry counter show it happened.

offline.name: Offline (simulated)
offline.description: Behaves as if the connection was lost.
offline.expected: An offline banner appears, queries wait instead of failing and no request is sent. When you leave this scenario they resume by themselves.

seed.label: Seed
seed.help: The same seed replays the same failures.

cache.resetOnChange: Reset cached data when the scenario changes
cache.hint: Turn it off to see how the app treats stale data when a refresh fails.

observed.title: Observed behavior
observed.empty: No requests yet. Use the probe below or browse the Pokédex.
observed.recovered: Recovered: a request succeeded after {count} failed attempts.
